title: Pontotoc baseball sets Dec. 18 drawing for a freezer stocked with local beef
excerpt: The Warrior baseball announcement lists tickets at $20 each or six for $100. The booster group plans to carry the Dec. 18 drawing on Facebook Live.
locality: Pontotoc Junior High and Pontotoc High School baseball, Pontotoc, Mississippi.

sources.title: Pontotoc Athletics announcement and Warrior baseball raffle flyer

facts.statement: Pontotoc Warrior Baseball will draw a winner Friday, Dec. 18, for a new deep freezer stocked with beef from Mississippi Beef Bros. Pontotoc Athletics announced the annual raffle Sunday evening.
facts.evidence: Caption calls the raffle annual. Flyer identifies the sport, new freezer, beef supplier and Dec. 18 drawing. The supplier logo reads Pontotoc, MS.
facts.date_context: Pontotoc Athletics shared the notice on Sunday evening, Nov. 22, Central time. The drawing is Friday, Dec. 18.
facts.locality: Pontotoc Junior High and Pontotoc High School baseball, Pontotoc, Mississippi.
facts.identities: Pontotoc Warrior Baseball, the baseball booster group and Mississippi Beef Bros.

facts.statement: Tickets cost $20 each or $100 for six. Six bought individually would cost $120. The baseball program directs people with ticket questions to a Pontotoc Junior High or Pontotoc High School baseball player or coach.
facts.evidence: Read both prices and the junior high/high school ticket contacts directly from the flyer. Six times $20 is $120.
facts.date_context: Pontotoc Athletics shared the notice on Sunday evening, Nov. 22, Central time. The drawing is Friday, Dec. 18.
facts.locality: Pontotoc Junior High and Pontotoc High School baseball, Pontotoc, Mississippi.
facts.identities: Pontotoc Warrior Baseball, the baseball booster group and Mississippi Beef Bros.

facts.statement: The flyer says the drawing will be carried on the Pontotoc Baseball Booster Facebook Live. It lists the time as 1:00 without specifying a.m. or p.m. Viewers can check the booster page for the broadcast time.
facts.evidence: The graphic reads December 18th at 1:00 on the Pontotoc Baseball Booster Facebook Live. No meridiem or separate ticket cutoff is stated.

facts.identities: Pontotoc Warrior Baseball, the baseball booster group and Mississippi Beef Bros.

paragraphs.text: Pontotoc Warrior Baseball will draw a winner Friday, Dec. 18, for a new deep freezer stocked with beef from Mississippi Beef Bros. Pontotoc Athletics announced the annual raffle Sunday evening.

Tickets cost $20 each or $100 for six. Six bought individually would cost $120. The baseball program directs people with ticket questions to a Pontotoc Junior High or Pontotoc High School baseball player or coach.

The flyer says the drawing will be carried on the Pontotoc Baseball Booster Facebook Live. It lists the time as 1:00 without specifying a.m. or p.m. Viewers can check the booster page for the broadcast time.
